accounting.categoryPrecedence: The first matching quarantine category wins; categories are disjoint within a table.

quarantineCategoryDefinitions.organizations.missing_required: Name, key, or timezone is null or blank.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.organizations.duplicate_key: A lower source ID has the same case-insensitive trimmed key.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.organizations.invalid_timezone: Timezone is not one of the explicit Rails-label mappings.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.users.missing_required: Login, email, or name is null or blank.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.users.duplicate_login: A lower source ID has the same case-insensitive trimmed login.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.users.duplicate_email: A lower source ID has the same case-insensitive trimmed email after login precedence.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.roles.unknown_role: Role name is null or is not admin, manager, or owner.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.roles.retired_owner_role: Resource-level owner authorization is deliberately not migrated.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.roles.invalid_scope: Admin is scoped or manager is not scoped to a concrete Organization.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.roles.orphan_scope: The manager role references a missing Organization.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.roles.unassigned_role: No existing source user is joined to the supported role.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.roles_users.orphan_user: The join references a missing source user.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.roles_users.orphan_role: The join references a missing source role.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.roles_users.role_not_importable: The referenced role fails the supported shape or organization checks.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.roles_users.duplicate_join: A prior row has the same user and role IDs.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.people.orphan_organization: Organization ID is null or references a missing source organization.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.people.missing_first_name: First name is null or blank.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.visits.orphan_person: Person ID is null or references a missing source person.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.services.orphan_person: Person ID is null or references a missing source person.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.services.unknown_service_type: Service type is null or is not MEMBERSHIP, EAB, or CLASS.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.notes.unsupported_target_type: Notable type is null or is not Person, Visit, or Service.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.notes.orphan_target: Notable ID is null or missing from the selected target table.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.tags.blank_name: Tag name is null or blank.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.tags.unowned_tag: No valid Person tagging connects the global source tag to an organization.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.taggings.unsupported_target: Target is not a Person in the tags context.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.taggings.orphan_tag: Tag ID is null or references a missing source tag.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.taggings.orphan_person: Person ID is null or references a missing source person.
quarantineCategoryDefinitions.taggings.duplicate_join: A lower tagging ID has the same tag, target, type, and context.

transformations.action: Map an accepted Rails timezone label to the listed IANA identifier before import.
Never copy crypted_password, salt, remember_token, activation_code, reset_code, or other bearer credentials; issue a temporary password and require change at first login.
Import the global user record but record an open issue when no valid platform or organization role survives preflight.
Map supported legacy role shapes through roleMappings; roles_users supplies the user side.
Derive displayName from trimmed firstName and lastName; do not trust legacy full_name.
Set normalizedEmail to lowercase trimmed email while retaining the display value.
Set normalizedPhone to digits plus an optional leading plus while retaining the display value.
Import all rows; record an issue for every row after the lowest source ID in an organization-scoped normalized-email group.
Import all rows; record an issue for every row after the lowest source ID in an organization-scoped normalized-phone group.
Convert years outside 1900 through the migration-year to null and record an issue.
Convert a non-null created_by_id or updated_by_id without a source user to null and record one issue per affected source row.
Map volunteer=false to project and volunteer=true to volunteering.
Convert a zero arrived_at, start_at, or end_at to null and record an issue; the migrated row remains an import candidate when its person exists.
Round a nonnegative finite legacy duration to integer seconds; negative values become null with an issue.
Preserve rounded source duration and record an issue when complete timestamps imply a different duration.
Preserve historical timestamps but record an issue when start precedes arrival, end exists without start, or end precedes start; new writes reject these shapes.
Map service_type_id through serviceTypeMappings.
Interpret both start_date and end_date as inclusive organization-local dates.
Preserve historical dates and record an issue when end_date precedes start_date; new writes reject this shape.
Map Person, Visit, or Service to exactly one explicit foreign key and derive organization ownership through that target.
Create one organization-owned tag per distinct organization reached through valid Person taggings; record legacy identity mappings for every output row.
Within an organization, map case-insensitively equal source names to the lowest canonical tag ID and record an issue for each merged source tag.
Derive organizationId from the valid tagged Person and map to that organization's canonical tag.

reportIssueCategoryDefinitions.discard_legacy_credentials: Candidate user has legacy credential material that is discarded and replaced at cutover.
reportIssueCategoryDefinitions.user_without_membership: Candidate user has no surviving platform or organization authorization.
reportIssueCategoryDefinitions.duplicate_normalized_email: A prior person in the organization has the same nonblank normalized email.
reportIssueCategoryDefinitions.duplicate_normalized_phone: A prior person in the organization has the same nonblank normalized phone.
reportIssueCategoryDefinitions.invalid_year_of_birth_to_null: Year of birth is outside 1900 through 2026 and becomes null.
reportIssueCategoryDefinitions.orphan_audit_user_to_null: At least one non-null audit user ID is missing and becomes null.
reportIssueCategoryDefinitions.zero_datetime_to_null: At least one visit datetime is a MySQL zero value and becomes null.
reportIssueCategoryDefinitions.negative_duration_to_null: Legacy visit duration is negative and becomes null.
reportIssueCategoryDefinitions.duration_timestamp_mismatch: Rounded source duration differs from the interval between complete start/end timestamps.
reportIssueCategoryDefinitions.visit_start_before_arrival: Visit start timestamp precedes arrival timestamp.
reportIssueCategoryDefinitions.visit_end_without_start: Visit has an end timestamp but no start timestamp.
reportIssueCategoryDefinitions.visit_end_before_start: Visit end timestamp precedes start timestamp.
reportIssueCategoryDefinitions.service_end_before_start: Service end date precedes start date.
reportIssueCategoryDefinitions.merge_duplicate_tenant_tag_name: A source tag maps to an organization where a lower source tag has the same case-insensitive name.

privacy.reportContents: Aggregate counts, category identifiers, schema/rules hashes, and source label only.
privacy.issuePersistence: Store source table/id plus a SHA-256 payload fingerprint and narrowly sanitized category detail.
